user_decision.label: Stable single-card Archive reliability and recovery composition

composition.surface: retain one Breakdown-scoped archive-card in the existing completion locus from activation through terminal classification
composition.state_change: change only the static non-color mark, exact status sentence, and one current-action slot in the original Archive action position
prohibited: toast, dialog, page-global banner, or page-global spinner
blind resend, automatic Retry, or in-flight Cancel
optimistic Pool removal or inferred success
timer, auto-dismissal, ellipsis animation, or repeated motion
persistence beyond the approved current-tab descriptor
theme-ID product behavior or copy branch

copy.unknown: We couldn’t confirm whether this Scratch was archived.
copy.reconciling: Checking whether this Scratch was archived…
copy.forced_reload: Checking the Archive request from before this reload…
copy.storage_failure: Archive couldn’t start because this tab couldn’t keep its recovery details.
copy.rejected: Archive stopped because this Scratch is no longer ready.
copy.conflict: Archive couldn’t finish because this Scratch changed while the result was being checked.

state_mapping.pending: retain selected Scratch/card and focusable aria-disabled current-action position; no Check again, Retry, Cancel, resend, or optimistic change
state_mapping.unknown: retain the same descriptor/operation and expose read-only Check again without resend
state_mapping.reconciling: retain the Check again position as a focusable inactive current-action target while classifying the same operation
state_mapping.not_applied: focus Retry, expose Retry plus Cancel, and let Retry alone reuse the logical operation identity and return to pending
state_mapping.storage_failure: no command ran; focus Cancel and return to current completion/reopen truth, where a later explicit Archive is a new attempt
state_mapping.rejected_or_conflict: show current authority where available, focus Cancel, and expose no Retry, overwrite, compensation, inferred success, or stale completion action
state_mapping.applied_or_already_applied: announce success once, remove the card with the selected Scratch, and perform the canonical visible-order/null/empty handoff without a lingering success card

reload_recovery.entry: validate the current-tab descriptor and reconcile before initial Inbox projection, focusing the recovery heading and never flashing ordinary completion
reload_recovery.applied: use the same terminal success handoff
reload_recovery.not_applied: show the exact not-applied card over current complete/reopen truth with Retry and Cancel
reload_recovery.unknown: show the exact unknown card with Check again
reload_recovery.conflict: show the exact non-retriable conflict card with Cancel
reload_recovery.invalid_descriptor: Task 161/126 discards invalid, foreign, or stale descriptors without a DP-VQ12 surface or mutation

cancel.pre_dispatch: retain Task 159 ordinary Cancel semantics before mutation
cancel.in_flight: pending, unknown, and reconciling expose no Cancel or Escape dismissal
cancel.terminal: dismiss only the terminal result and return to current completion/reopen or working truth; never abort, roll back, compensate, or hide uncertainty

focus_accessibility_lifetime.focus: activation retains the stable current-action slot; unknown focuses Check again; reconciling retains it; not-applied focuses Retry; storage failure/rejected/conflict focuses Cancel; reload focuses the recovery heading
focus_accessibility_lifetime.status: one visible polite atomic status announces each changed exact sentence once, never per rerender; static text and mark carry meaning without color or motion
focus_accessibility_lifetime.lifetime: nonterminal state persists until the same descriptor is authoritatively classified; no timer, theme/mode reset, Scratch-switch escape, route-intent escape, or conflicting-action replay

motion.ordinary: card content, action, terminal removal, and focus changes are immediate and static
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, blur transition, skeleton, shimmer, spinner, progress loop, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, ellipsis animation, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, focus, announcement, timing, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: one ruled technical Archive operation card with static state glyph and canonical current-action slot
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: one pinned filing note whose stamp line and single action row change in place
theme_mapping.neumorphism: one raised Archive card with inset static status line and stable action capsule position
theme_mapping.claymorphism: one shape-preserving clay Archive object with static status inset and no bounce
theme_mapping.origami: one seam-bound Archive sheet whose printed status and action change without a new fold or panel
theme_mapping.terminal: one variable-driven [archive:*] system frame and current command line with no blink, spinner, or glow loop
theme_mapping.retro-mac: one hard 1-bit in-section Archive alert whose message and default action change in the same window
theme_mapping.graphite: one restrained editorial Archive card with fixed rule, static mark, and stable action row

implementation_boundary.excludes: product implementation in Task 119, SCHEMA Archive transaction/result/reconciliation changes, Task 126 or Task 161 behavior changes, new persistence, starting Task 162, Phase 24 close, adjacent fallback, and theme-ID logic

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 119 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased; Task 162 is not started by this receipt and Phase 24 close remains unavailable
